liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wagoner's Lad** (1 other source): Billy played this one solo on a four-string banjo [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **Down Yonder**: rare: 7 archived performances [5]
- **Freight Train Boogie**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [5]
- **Blue Railroad Train**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 3 archived performances [5]
- **Your Lone Journey**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **All About You**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [5]
- **The Old Home**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [5]
- **Going Down The Road Feeling Bad**: back after 227 archived shows (1392 days); rare: 3 archived performances [5]
- **Otto Wood the Bandit**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [5]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2023-03-03** (recommended): source not stated; 46 songs; 189 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **billystrings2023-03-03.billystrings2023003-03gman**: source not stated; 44 songs; 192 min [2]

## Around the show

- The concert was a celebration of Doc Watson's 100th birthday, held at the Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2023-03-03**: source: Beyerdynamic CK950's > Sound Devices MixPre 6ii [1]. Also: Reviewer notes the taper is still using Beyer Hypers microphones, implying that gear was used for this recording [4]
- **billystrings2023-03-03.billystrings2023003-03gman**: taped by G-Man; transferred by G-Man; source: Audio Technica AT2020> Zoom H5 [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by panetory.com: [Billy Strings Lawrence Joel Veterans Memorial Coliseum Winston Salem Mar 3 2023 Poster 2026](https://panetory.com/billy-strings-lawrence-joel-veterans-memorial-coliseum-winston-salem-mar-3-2023-poster) [6]
